Therefore,

:width:`400px`

* Attention mechanisms are different from fully-connected layers or pooling layers due to inclusion of the volitional cues.

Using the volitional cue based on variable selection criteria,
this form of attention is more deliberate.

![Attention mechanisms bias selection over values (sensory inputs) via attention pooling, which incorporates queries (volitional cues) and keys (nonvolitional cues).](../img/qkv.svg)
:label:`fig_qkv`

As shown in :numref:`fig_qkv`,
we can design attention pooling
so that the given query (volitional cue) can interact with keys (nonvolitional cues),
which guides bias selection over values (sensory inputs).

In the context of attention mechanisms,
we refer to volitional cues as *queries*.

In this framework,
subjects selectively direct the spotlight of attention
using both the *nonvolitional cue* and *volitional cue*.

proposed_definition_en: a task-dependent cue that deliberately directs attention; in attention mechanisms, it corresponds to a query.

evidence_contexts.source_text:
As mentioned in :numref:`sec_vgg`,
the VGG network uses 5 convolutional blocks.

The original VGG network had 5 convolutional blocks,
among which the first two have one convolutional layer each
and the latter three contain two convolutional layers each.
## [**VGG Network**]
In order to extract the content features and style features of the image, we can select the output of certain layers in the VGG network.
The fully-connected part of the VGG network is identical to that covered in AlexNet.

For example,
the original single-shot multibox detection paper
adopts a VGG network truncated before the
classification layer :cite:`Liu.Anguelov.Erhan.ea.2016`,
while ResNet has also been commonly used.

Like AlexNet and LeNet,
the VGG Network can be partitioned into two parts:
the first consisting mostly of convolutional and pooling layers
and the second consisting of fully-connected layers.

proposed_definition_en: a named convolutional neural network architecture with stacked convolutional blocks and fully connected layers
